name: ExcelX
description: Convert spreadsheets (xlsx/xls/csv) into SQLite databases and export them back, so anyone can query their data with SQL or the DBX AI assistant.
releaseNotes: Experience and reliability release: real per-batch conversion progress; replace-or-copy prompt when re-converting (no more _2 pile-up); Chinese date formats; numeric xlsx export cells; column-aware AI question suggestions; async always-on-top file dialogs (fixes 120s timeout and lost dialogs); exact i64 parsing and inference-level leading-zero guard; 32,767-char cell truncation; export lock detection with guidance; PK duplicates reported with row numbers; hidden sheets labeled and excluded by default; wide-sheet preview cap.

zh-CN.name: ExcelX
zh-CN.description: 把 Excel / CSV 表格转换成 SQLite 数据库，随时导出回表格——让不懂数据库的人也能用 SQL 或 AI 助手直接查询、分析自己的数据。
